name: Slack 归档

configuration.label: Slack OAuth Client ID
configuration.description: Slack App 的 Client ID，不是凭据本身。

configuration.label: Slack OAuth Client Secret 引用
configuration.description: 只填写中央部署环境中的凭据引用，例如 ${MOTE_SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET}；不填写明文密钥。

configuration.label: Slack 回调地址
configuration.description: 必须与 Slack App 的 Redirect URL 完全一致，例如 https://central.example.com/oauth/slack/callback；归档与发送授权共用此回调地址。

access: Owner-selected Slack channels and direct messages, read with the owner's Slack user token; this is a personal archive, not a workspace bot
Archive authorization requests read scopes only. Sending needs a second user-scope authorization and never follows from the archive connection
Slack client secret stays in the central secret reference; OAuth user tokens stay in host-bound instance state and are removed on disconnect

Reads are limited to conversations.list/info, conversations.history/replies, users.info and auth.test. chat.postMessage runs only inside a host-dispatched, owner-confirmed message.send action with the send token
No model calls, no workspace-wide scan, and no other Slack write methods

sourceCatalog.title: Slack 归档
sourceCatalog.body: 个人归档已勾选的频道、私信与群组私信，按消息身份保留版本
sourceCatalog.note: 安装不等于授权。归档授权只读；发送需要第二次授权，并在行动平台逐条确认，问一问不能发送。
